title: Applicability, Jurisdiction and Material Perimeter
assessment_question: Has the organisation documented its digital personal data inventory, established jurisdictional boundaries, and identified all digital collection touchpoints?

title: Lawful Basis and Ground of Processing
assessment_question: Is every personal data processing activity formally mapped to a distinct statutory ground (valid consent under Section 6 or an exhaustive legitimate use under Section 7)?

title: Itemised and Pre-Consent Notice
assessment_question: Does the organisation provide a clear, standalone, itemised notice before or at the time of requesting consent, detailing data types, purpose, rights, and DPBI complaint procedures?

title: Historical Notice for Pre-Existing Consent
assessment_question: Has the organisation planned or dispatched retrospective notices to existing Data Principals whose consent was captured prior to the commencement of the Act?

title: Multilingual Notice Option Mechanism
assessment_question: Does the organisation provide an operational mechanism (e.g. language toggle or accessible translated views) allowing Data Principals to view notices in English or any Eighth Schedule language?

title: Unbundled Affirmative Consent Architecture
assessment_question: Are consent mechanisms unbundled, free from dark patterns and pre-ticked checkboxes, and captured through clear affirmative action with cryptographic timestamps?

title: Consent Withdrawal Mechanism and Comparable Ease
assessment_question: Does the organisation provide an accessible, frictionless mechanism allowing Data Principals to withdraw consent with ease comparable to granting it, triggering automated cessation of processing?

title: Consent Manager Interoperability
assessment_question: Is the organisation equipped with technical APIs and interoperability workflows to receive, verify, and execute consent instructions from registered Consent Managers?

title: Voluntary Provision Legitimate Uses
assessment_question: Where processing relies on voluntary provision under Section 7(a), is processing strictly confined to the specific purpose for which the data was provided?

title: Employment Functions Legitimate Uses
assessment_question: Does the organisation process employee personal data strictly within the boundaries of employment functions, benefits administration, and asset protection without excessive surveillance?

title: Accountability and Non-Delegable Responsibility
assessment_question: Does the organisation maintain enterprise-wide governance, policies, and audit mechanisms ensuring accountability for all processing conducted internally and through external vendors?

title: Data Processor Engagement and Contractual Governance
assessment_question: Are all third-party Data Processors bound by legally executed Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) incorporating mandatory Rule 7 clauses?

title: Data Quality, Accuracy and Decision Safeguards
assessment_question: Does the organisation maintain data validation, deduplication, and quality controls to guarantee accuracy when personal data affects Data Principals or is disclosed to third parties?

title: Technical and Organisational Security Safeguards (TOMs)
assessment_question: Has the organisation implemented verified technical and organisational security measures (access controls, vulnerability assessments, network segmentation, multi-factor authentication) to prevent data breaches?

title: Encryption, Key Governance and Access Controls
assessment_question: Is all digital personal data encrypted at rest (e.g. AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+ / 1.3), supported by secure KMS key rotation and least-privilege access?

title: Personal Data Breach Incident Response and Triage
assessment_question: Does the organisation maintain an operational Personal Data Breach Incident Response Plan detailing detection, escalation, containment, and root-cause analysis?

title: Dual Breach Intimation (DPBI and Affected Principals)
assessment_question: Are communication templates, secure channels, and procedural workflows established to execute mandatory breach intimations to both the DPBI and affected Data Principals?

title: Purpose Fulfillment and Automated Erasure
assessment_question: Does the organisation maintain defined retention schedules with automated or verified data purging when the specified purpose expires or consent is withdrawn?

title: Statutory Retention Exceptions Register
assessment_question: Has the organisation compiled a Legal Retention Register documenting the specific statutory provisions requiring extended retention of records?

title: Data Principal Rights: Access and Information Summary
assessment_question: Does the organisation maintain a secure portal and workflow to provide Data Principals with a comprehensive summary of their processed personal data and a list of sharing partners?

title: Data Principal Rights: Correction, Update and Erasure
assessment_question: Are procedures and self-service features in place allowing Data Principals to correct, update, complete, or request erasure of their personal data?

title: Grievance Redressal Mechanism and Officer Publication
assessment_question: Has the organisation published the contact details of an authorized Grievance Officer and established an SLA-tracked grievance redressal ticketing system?

title: Data Principal Right to Nominate
assessment_question: Does the organisation provide an account feature or mechanism allowing Data Principals to nominate an individual to manage their personal data in the event of death or incapacity?

title: Verifiable Parental Consent for Children and Disabled
assessment_question: Does the organisation maintain an operational age-gating mechanism and a verifiable parental/guardian consent verification process before processing children's personal data?

title: Prohibition on Child Tracking, Profiling and Targeted Ads
assessment_question: Are technical controls enforced to completely disable tracking scripts, behavioural analytics, user profiling, and targeted advertising whenever an account belongs to a minor?

title: Significant Data Fiduciary Governance (Resident DPO)
assessment_question: Has the organisation formally appointed an India-resident Data Protection Officer with independent reporting lines directly to the Board of Directors?

title: SDF Impact Assessments (DPIA) and Independent Audits
assessment_question: Does the organisation conduct periodic Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for high-risk processing activities and engage an independent Data Auditor for annual compliance audits?

title: Cross-Border Data Transfers and Negative List
assessment_question: Does the organisation maintain an inventory of all cross-border data flows and enforce controls ensuring personal data is not transferred to blacklisted countries?

title: Sectoral Data Localization Preservation
assessment_question: Does the organisation comply with higher sectoral data localization mandates (such as RBI directives requiring payment data to be stored exclusively in India)?

title: Statutory Penalty Deficit Exposure and Sanction Audit
assessment_question: Has the organisation assessed its potential statutory penalty exposure across the five statutory tiers and established mitigating measures recognized under Section 28(2)?
